title: Handley Page Halifax NR179
memorial_details: Rectangular, buff-coloured stone with top third sloping at a slight angle. Square, black, dedicatory plaque recessed into the sloping face of the stone. The squadron crest and a Halifax bomber are outlined in white. Dedication is in white, upper and lower-case letters.
inscription: Squadron crest: SQUADRON / 466 466 / ROYAL AUSTRALIAN / AIR FORCE / BRAVE AND TRUE // Inscription: Halifax III HD-C NR179 / 466 Squadron RAAF / Crashed near this location, (9 miles WNW of Driffield) NR179 took off 3rd March 1945 at 1823 hrs. / from RAF Driffield, on a mission to Kamen (Germany). On return to Base, while waiting to land, they were / hit by gunfire from a Luftwaffe JU-88 night fighter. NR179 caught fire and crashed at 0110 hrs on 4th March / 1945. / NR179 Crew / (7 Names) / This memorial plaque commemorates their ultimate sacrifice and pays tribute to all victims of war. / Their Names Liveth Forever More / We will remember them / Lest We Forget
